questions.questionHtml:
Rearrange the following parts (P, Q, R, S) to form a coherent and meaningful paragraph.

P) The talks focused primarily on strengthening Ukraine’s defense capabilities and ensuring continued U.S. humanitarian and financial support.
Q) The meeting took place in Washington during the Ukrainian Prime Minister’s official visit to the United States.
R) Both leaders reaffirmed their shared commitment to defending democratic values and upholding Ukraine’s sovereignty.

questions.solution: The paragraph logically begins with the main event (S), followed by the setting of the meeting (Q), then the main discussion topics (P), and finally the conclusion or outcome (R).

questions.question: Identify the correct use of the apostrophe in the following sentence. Despite being one of the most reputed universities in the region, the institutions policy on students grievances left many questioning the administration’s commitment to transparency.
questions.questionHtml:
Identify the correct use of the apostrophe in the following sentence.

Despite being one of the most reputed universities in the region, the institutions policy on students grievances left many questioning the administration’s commitment to transparency.
questions.solution:
The noun institution is singular and requires an apostrophe before s to show possession — institution's policy.
The noun students is plural, so the apostrophe appears after s — students’ grievances — indicating that the grievances belong to multiple students.
Hence, the grammatically correct structure is the institution's policy on students’ grievances.

questions.questionHtml:
Read the passage below carefully and fill in the blanks with the most suitable words from the options given.

With the onset of October, parts of North India have begun experiencing an early shift in weather. The days are gradually becoming shorter, and the evenings have turned noticeably __________ (1). Meteorologists have reported that a fresh western disturbance is likely to bring a further drop in temperature, marking the __________ (2) of the winter season ahead of time.

Which word best fits blank (1)?
questions.solution: The clue word is “evenings have turned noticeably…”. During the transition from autumn to winter, evenings in North India become cold, not hot or humid. “Chilly” accurately conveys the cool and brisk feeling associated with cold weather.

questions.question: Read the passage carefully and answer the following questions. After the grand festive season of Diwali and Dhanteras, the Indian bullion market witnessed a sharp 30% fall in silver and gold prices, shocking both traders and investors. The steep decline came after months of high demand fueled by traditional purchases, wedding season rush, and global economic uncertainties that earlier pushed prices to record highs. However, once the festive buying frenzy ended, market corrections began quickly as supply outpaced demand. Experts suggest that the drop was not entirely unexpected. During festive months, people buy large quantities of gold and silver for religious and cultural reasons, creating temporary price inflation. When the celebrations end, the sudden decrease in consumer demand, coupled with international market adjustments and a stronger rupee, results in reduced prices. The price correction also reflected easing global inflation rates and the U.S. Federal Reserve’s stable interest policy, which diverted many investors toward more profitable asset classes like stocks. This decline has had mixed effects on the economy. Jewelry businesses faced considerable losses due to price volatility and reduced margins, while common buyers saw an opportunity to invest at lower prices. On the other hand, export-oriented sectors benefited from cheaper raw materials, particularly silver, which is widely used in industrial manufacturing. Economists believe that although short-term turbulence is likely, the long-term stability of the precious metals market will largely depend on global inflation trends, import policies, and geopolitical stability. Choose the most appropriate title for the passage.

Read the passage carefully and answer the following questions.

After the grand festive season of Diwali and Dhanteras, the Indian bullion market witnessed a sharp 30% fall in silver and gold prices, shocking both traders and investors. The steep decline came after months of high demand fueled by traditional purchases, wedding season rush, and global economic uncertainties that earlier pushed prices to record highs. However, once the festive buying frenzy ended, market corrections began quickly as supply outpaced demand.

Experts suggest that the drop was not entirely unexpected. During festive months, people buy large quantities of gold and silver for religious and cultural reasons, creating temporary price inflation. When the celebrations end, the sudden decrease in consumer demand, coupled with international market adjustments and a stronger rupee, results in reduced prices. The price correction also reflected easing global inflation rates and the U.S. Federal Reserve’s stable interest policy, which diverted many investors toward more profitable asset classes like stocks.

This decline has had mixed effects on the economy. Jewelry businesses faced considerable losses due to price volatility and reduced margins, while common buyers saw an opportunity to invest at lower prices. On the other hand, export-oriented sectors benefited from cheaper raw materials, particularly silver, which is widely used in industrial manufacturing. Economists believe that although short-term turbulence is likely, the long-term stability of the precious metals market will largely depend on global inflation trends, import policies, and geopolitical stability.

questions.solution: The passage explains that during festivals like Diwali and Dhanteras, demand for gold and silver rises sharply, inflating prices temporarily. After the festive season, as demand falls, prices undergo correction, leading to a significant drop. This cause-and-effect relationship is central to the passage’s argument.
